picks.editorial_note: A $39.5M ARPA-H-funded consortium spanning Boston University, Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell to build AI-enabled robotic catheters for remote stroke intervention represents exactly the kind of large-scale, multi-institutional translational research that can change clinical outcomes.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to 5% of its equity (potentially $100 billion) alongside SpaceX's giveaways raises major questions about wealth distribution and public benefit in the AI boom, with Georgetown economists weighing in on who actually benefits.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: A $30 million state-backed turbulence research center at Michigan State combining physics, computation, and AI signals serious institutional investment in foundational AI-driven science infrastructure.
picks.title: MSU trustees receive presentation on new turbulence research center, approve state capital outlay request

picks.editorial_note: A $3.2 million NIH-funded deep learning approach to screening for preclinical Alzheimer's via retinal imaging and blood biomarkers could enable earlier, less invasive diagnosis of a disease where early intervention matters most.
picks.title: What the eye may reveal about Alzheimer’s

picks.editorial_note: An EU-funded, Fraunhofer-led AI platform to personalize care for pancreatic cancer patients shows cross-border academic-industry collaboration translating directly into patient quality-of-life improvements.
picks.title: Improving Quality of Life for Patients With Pancreatic Cancer Through AI-Based Monitoring and Intervention Planning

picks.editorial_note: A $732,574 Schmidt Sciences grant to Brown and Vanderbilt researchers for an AI-assisted archaeological image-search platform demonstrates how AI tools are expanding research capacity in the humanities, backed by serious philanthropic funding.
picks.title: Brown archaeologist to co-lead AI project to advance understanding of ancient Andean empires

picks.editorial_note: UCF's Kidney-VLM vision-language model, combining imaging and patient history, could materially improve physicians' ability to diagnose kidney cancer and stones more efficiently.
picks.title: UCF Researchers Developing AI Model to Help Physicians Improve Kidney Care

picks.editorial_note: Weill Cornell's LabARIA agentic AI framework for catching clinical lab errors before they reach patients is a concrete example of AI improving patient safety in a high-stakes operational setting.
picks.title: AI System May Help Clinical Labs Spot Problems Before They Affect Patients
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: RPI's Quest2Dx model improves on existing methods for early Parkinson's screening using simple health questionnaires, a low-cost approach that could broaden access to earlier diagnosis.
picks.title: RPI Team Builds AI Model for More Effective Early Parkinson’s Screening

picks.editorial_note: VCU's recognized innovators are advancing single-cell AI analysis of human tissue, work with broad downstream implications for disease research across multiple conditions.
picks.title: VCU Innovators of the Year are unlocking new insights into human disease
